title: Hoppy
summary: A +1 war pick that heals its wielder with Revitalising Strike.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 1 Piercing, 5 ft melee, martial one-handed and dippable.
fields.Revitalising Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. On a melee weapon hit, deal normal damage plus proficiency bonus as Necrotic and restore 1d6 HP to yourself.
fields.Maiming Strike: Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Maimed for 2 turns.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action once per Short Rest. On a melee weapon hit, Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns.
fields.Weakening Strike: Action once per Short Rest. Make a nonlethal melee attack for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Weak Grip for 2 turns.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Lady Esther near Trielta Crags.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
